name: ttc-sim
description: Unofficial Toronto subway driving sim (fan project, not affiliated with the TTC)

scripts.bake: npm run bake:line1 && npm run bake:stations && npm run bake:profile && npm run bake:corridor && npm run bake:imagery
scripts.bake:derived: mkdir -p logs && PROFILE_ONLY=1 node scripts/bake-profile.mjs > logs/bake-profile.log
scripts.test:data: npm run -s bake:derived && if [ -n "$(ls scripts/raw/wiki-html 2>/dev/null)" ]; then WIKI_OFFLINE=1 node scripts/bake-stations-wiki.mjs > logs/bake-stations.log; else echo "test:data: no scripts/raw/wiki-html cache, station rebake skipped"; fi
scripts.test: npm run check:py && npm run test:data && npm run test:physics && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
